map.生成条数钳制在 1–50（缺省 5）。随机模式下每条取 1–3 层（可固定），每: The count is clamped to 1-50 (default 5). In random mode each style gets 1-3 layers (fixable), each layer has a 20% chance of inset (or force all inner/outer), offset-x and offset-y are random integers in -20..20, blur 0-40, spread -10..10, and colours come from a 10-colour palette (or one chosen colour) converted to rgba at 0.10-0.50 opacity; once offset/blur/spread are filled they are used as-is (0 means 0, unlike a blank field which stays random). In the elevation mode the i-th style is fixed to offset-x 0, offset-y i, blur 2i+2, spread 0, with opacity stepping down from 0.15 to 0.05 — a ready-to-use elevation scale. Layers are comma-joined into a box-shadow declaration and previewed on a 60 × 60 rounded swatch.
